## Design

### 2026-10-01 — Today I worked on the structural design and component selection for Hexabug, my 6-legged walking robot. I sketched three different chassis configurations and selected a flat rectangular body style to

**9h**

Today I worked on the structural design and component selection for Hexabug, my 6-legged walking robot. I sketched three different chassis configurations and selected a flat rectangular body style to maintain a low center of gravity. This layout provides optimal stability for the micro servos and offers sufficient mounting surface area for the Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, PCA9685 driver board, power regulators, and battery.
